Report_RepeatMeasurements function

Source: R/Report_RepeatMeasurements.R
Report_RepeatMeasurements.Rd

`r lifecycle::badge("experimental")`

Generates the Repeat Measurements report for the repeat-measure KRIs (`kri0020a`–`f`, `cou0020a`–`f`): consecutive identical vital sign values at study, country, site and participant level, with a participant listing, a vitals listing and a data table.

The flag rule, thresholds, minimum windows and blood pressure view set the report's starting settings; reviewers can change them in the report's Settings panel, which recomputes every participant flag in the browser.

Usage

Report_RepeatMeasurements(
  dfResults = NULL,
  dfMetrics = NULL,
  lListings = NULL,
  dSnapshotDate = NULL,
  nWindowLength = NULL,
  strFlagRule = c("count", "rate"),
  vFlagThresholds = NULL,
  nMinWindows = 1,
  strBPMode = c("separate", "combined", "both"),
  bExport = TRUE,
  strOutputDir = getwd(),
  strOutputFile = NULL,
  strInputPath = system.file("report", "Report_RepeatMeasurements.Rmd", package =
    "gsm.kri")
)

Arguments

dfResults

`data.frame` Reporting results. With `kri0020` results the report reconciles with the KRI and colours sites by their KRI flag.

dfMetrics

`data.frame` Reporting metrics. The window length and thresholds come from the `kri0020` rows when present.

lListings

`list` with `Mapped_VS` and `Mapped_SUBJ`.

dSnapshotDate

`Date` Shown in the subtitle. Default: the latest `dfResults$SnapshotDate`, if any.

nWindowLength

`integer` Window length when `dfMetrics` has none. See [rm_Classify()].

strFlagRule

`character` Participant flag rule, `"count"` (default) or `"rate"`. See [rm_Classify()].

vFlagThresholds

`numeric` Amber and Red thresholds for `strFlagRule`. Default `NULL`: 2 and 3 repeating windows, or the `kri0020` rate thresholds. See [rm_Classify()].

nMinWindows

`numeric` Windows a participant needs for a flag. Default 1.

strBPMode

`character` Blood pressure view: `"separate"` (default, systolic and diastolic BP), `"combined"` (paired BP only) or `"both"`.

bExport

`logical` Show the CSV download buttons. Default: `TRUE`.

strOutputDir

`string` Output directory. Default: working directory.

strOutputFile

`string` Output filename. Default: `Report_RepeatMeasurements.html`.

strInputPath

`string` Path to the template `Rmd`.

Value

File path of the saved report HTML, returned invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
Report_RepeatMeasurements(
  dfResults = lReporting$Reporting_Results,
  dfMetrics = lReporting$Reporting_Metrics,
  lListings = list(
    Mapped_VS = lMapped$Mapped_VS,
    Mapped_SUBJ = lMapped$Mapped_SUBJ
  )
)
} # }
